description: tsconfig path aliases: "@lib/db" and "utils/log" resolve to repository files through paths in tsconfig.base.json (extended by the root and apps/web), so they are not package usage. The npm "utils" dependency is genuinely unused. zod is used, and the "*" -> node_modules fallback must not hide that. @acme/ui is a workspace package that apps/web declares and imports, so it is used.
